en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Aamir, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Aban, from Muhammad who said,
‘It was so that whenever Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> found a louse in the Masjid, buried it among the pebbles’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Amir, from Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah ibn Ayyub, from Aban from Muhammad who has said the following: “
When Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, would see lice in Masjid he would cover it with sand.”
